name: Rival Schools: United by Fate
description: A recompilation setup kit for Rival Schools: United by Fate.
author_notes: Supply the complete listed Redump CUE/BIN set and your own SCPH1001 (USA) BIOS dump; the kit itself also accepts a CHD of the same dump, but Retro matches CUE/BIN only. First-run setup generates and compiles the game on your machine and also builds a diagnostic variant: create an empty diagnostic-mode.txt next to the setup executable (or run it with --diagnostic) to use it, and --collect-diagnostics zips the runtime's report files for a GitHub issue. Netplay is not qualified. Native Linux and macOS owned-input setup and gameplay remain unverified. This is the Arcade Disc program; the Evolution Disc is the separate rival-schools-evolution-psx entry. Save carry-over between the two is untested.
notes: Wave 4 v0.1.0 owned-input setup release. Source fallback is pinned to the exact public commit that produced the release assets. Windows: exact-package clean-extract setup, generation, compilation and headless start checks passed on the release pin; play testing of the private builds this kit derives from is recorded in the title README. Native Linux/macOS owned-input setup and gameplay remain unverified. The single macos glob matches both the arm64 and the x64 setup zip.
